scripts.lint: eslint src worker shared scripts tests vite.config.js eslint.config.mjs --max-warnings 0
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm test && npm run build
scripts.db:seed: node scripts/generate-seed.mjs && wrangler d1 execute campusbridge-portal-db --local --file scripts/seed.sql
scripts.deploy:live: npm run build && wrangler deploy --env production
scripts.db:migrate:live: wrangler d1 migrations apply campusbridge-live-db --remote --env production
